build_step3vl_model: build a Step3VLForConditionalGeneration multimodal model with vLLM config for image-text generation
create_vision_transformer: create a Step3VisionTransformer with embeddings, attention layers, and MLP blocks for image encoding
run_mm_processor: run a Step3VLMultiModalProcessor to replace image placeholders with patch feature token IDs in prompts
load_model_weights: load pretrained Step3VL model weights using AutoWeightsLoader with HF-to-vLLM prefix mapping
compute_model_logits: compute language model logits from hidden states for conditional text generation
